claim: Across two independent 2025-2026 studies, proposed agentic pathology systems report higher accuracy than the compared multimodal/pathology baselines on complex evaluation tasks such as visual question answering and multiple-choice diagnosis.

evidence.quote: Experiments show that PathoSage effectively mitigates VQA hallucinations and classifier disagreement, outperforming strong pathology MLLM and agentic baselines.
Experiments show that Patho-AgenticRAG significantly outperforms existing multimodal models in complex pathology tasks like multiple-choice diagnosis and visual question answering.

prediction.claim: By 2026-07-15, each paper’s results section will show at least one table or figure where the proposed agentic method exceeds all listed baselines on a visual question answering or multiple-choice diagnosis task.
prediction.checkable: Open the PDFs and verify that the reported results include metrics where the proposed methods outperform all compared baselines on VQA or multiple-choice diagnosis.

refutation_condition: If detailed results in either paper do not show the proposed method exceeding the compared baselines on VQA or multiple-choice diagnosis, or independent re-runs on those tasks fail to reproduce such an advantage, the claim is false.
